title: Information Security Bulletin Q3 2025 — Phishing Advisory and Patch Compliance
author: Thomas Carr, Information Security Officer
content:
TO: All Staff
FROM: Thomas Carr, Information Security Officer
DATE: 2025-09-01
RE: Information Security Bulletin Q3 2025 — Phishing Advisory and Patch Compliance
CLASSIFICATION: INTERNAL ONLY

1. PHISHING CAMPAIGN ADVISORY

The IT Security team has identified an increase in targeted phishing emails directed at employees across the Engineering and Finance departments. The current campaign impersonates internal HR communications and uses spoofed sender addresses resembling hr-notifications@company.com. If you receive an unexpected email asking you to verify your credentials, reset a password, or access a new HR portal, do not interact with any embedded links. Report suspected phishing emails immediately to security@company.com and do not delete them, as they are required for forensic analysis. A guidance note with screenshot examples of the spoofed messages has been posted to the IT intranet under Security & Compliance.

2. PASSWORD POLICY UPDATE — EFFECTIVE 2025-09-15

Consistent with the annual security review, the company's password policy is updated effective 15 September 2025. Minimum password length increases from 10 to 14 characters. Passwords must include at least one uppercase letter, one numeral, and one special character. Passwords must not contain the employee's name, employee ID, or any previously used password from the last 12 cycles. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is now mandatory for all VPN and remote access sessions without exception. Employees who have not yet enrolled in MFA must do so by 2025-09-10 via the IT self-service portal at it-helpdesk.company.com. After the deadline, unenrolled accounts will be suspended pending manual review.

3. CRITICAL PATCH DEADLINE — 2025-09-14

Microsoft has issued patches addressing two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-37841 and CVE-2025-38102) affecting all Windows 10 and Windows 11 endpoints. Managed devices will receive patches automatically through the endpoint management system within 48 hours of this bulletin. Employees using personal devices for company access under the BYOD scheme must manually apply updates by 2025-09-14. Unpatched BYOD devices will be blocked from VPN access from that date without further notice. Contact it-helpdesk@company.com with any technical issues before the deadline.

4. INCIDENT REPORTING REMINDER

All security incidents — including suspected data breaches, lost or stolen devices, and accidental data disclosures — must be reported to security@company.com within two hours of discovery. Any delay increases regulatory exposure under GDPR Article 33, which requires notification to the supervisory authority within 72 hours of a breach. The incident reporting form is available on the IT intranet under Security & Compliance. When in doubt, report; the security team will triage and classify the incident.
